text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, let us begin the meeting.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"My livestream" aimed at our fans!
I shall ensure it succeeds without fail!

text_block_list.name: Curren & Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~♪
Ooh~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Once again, thank you for your cooperation.
...I am determined to achieve this goal no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Pardon...? A livestream for the fans, hosted by me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ You seemed really keen on fan service lately!
So I thought a collab stream would be super lively~.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Is there any segment you'd like to try?
Machan and company welcome anything at all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Well, it is somewhat personal, so it is a bit awkward to say... but there is something I would like to attempt.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I would like to try managing the fans.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Because I receive our fans' cheers, I gain energy
to run my races. Seeing that, the fans in turn feel motivated to do their best—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I wish to preserve this wonderful cycle forever.
Therefore, I want to manage our fans so that
they can remain healthy in both mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Delivering energy to everyone, huh...?
Fufu, that sounds like a wonderful stream♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at the announcement for our collab stream!
It's already gotten this many Umanes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Already 3,000 people right now...! Even more should show up for the broadcast♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Over 3,000 people...
I am to manage that many individuals...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, no matter how difficult it may be, I will not give up...
I shall accomplish this without fail!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Lack of exercise, nutritional balance, sleep...
I must categorize them meticulously to provide
comprehensive advice...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Exercising together joyfully—
I shall perfect such a dance routine!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The centerpiece of streaming: gaming playthroughs!
The sense of accomplishment and solidarity from clearing a game enriches the soul!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ikuno Dictus carried out meticulous preparations for the stream. ...Before long—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Is the camera working properly...? Greetings, this is Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Today, let us all receive some energizing management from Ikuno-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno-san's self-management is flawless, after all!
Take good care of us, Teacher♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with pleasure. ...If it pleases you,
everyone watching may reference this as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a comment.
"I'm so curious about Iku-chan's management~"...
Fufu, please enjoy the stream.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The one indispensable thing for when I wake up...
is hot green tea.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: The catechins contained in green tea are optimal for preventing colds. I drink it every morning without fail.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ikuno-san, Ikuno-san!
"I'm too busy in the morning to brew green tea~," they say!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case, plain hot water is also effective.
Warming a chilled digestive tract
promotes healthy digestion.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I might actually be able to do that!"
Uh-huh! Everyone, be sure to try a good morning cup♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A short while after breakfast, light exercise.
This helps prevent many lifestyle-related diseases.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, what I put into practice is—
the "Ikuno-Style Original Calisthenics."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...! How exciting.
Machan would like to try it as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: We plan to upload these exercises as a video clip later. Please feel free to move your bodies along with the video.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, here is a comment.
..."Will I be able to stay healthy forever just like Iku-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I promise. If you manage yourself with an iron will, results will follow without fail.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Because that is my management.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking through the school grounds, I happened to spot the two of them looking overjoyed and stopped in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Ikuno-san's lifestyle is amazing!"
"Guess I'll rethink my own daily routine."
...Fufu, look at all these wonderful comments!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
I must keep myself disciplined as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So that I may continue running in races indefinitely,
I shall never neglect this self-management.
